correctness.rationale: The self-inclusive sequential XOR sweep is a product of involutory local updates, hence invertible with scan matrix F=(I+L)^(-1)(I+U). Cyclic rotation and relabeling reduce the single deleted edge to oriented gap k. Unimodular elimination over F_2[x] leaves a 2x2 block H whose determinant is (x^k+1)(x^(n-k)+1); its entry gcd gives d1=gcd(x^k+1,(x^n+1)/(x+1)) and d2=product/d1. Gcd with x^t+1 gives fixed dimensions g+h-epsilon, while invariant-factor order and Moebius inversion yield the full cycle census and sharp order. The boundary k=1 is explicitly handled. Separately enumerated actual binary scan state maps for canonical gaps n=4..8 and times 1..16 and reproduced all fixed counts. The sparse cycle comparison uses the known cyclic-ascent classification, with an explicit caution that the submitted proof quotes rather than rederives that all-scan cycle lemma. This is set-conjugacy, not linear similarity.
